answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 41150 Country: India Title: If ejaculation occurs during sleeping, does fast break Question: If ejaculation occurs during sleeping, does fast break? And what are the conditions at that time? Answer ID: 41150 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1276/845/H=1433) Fast does not break if someone ejaculates while sleeping as well as it does not make fast makrooh.
